scenes.headline: Meals planned around her night shifts.
scenes.vo: Her meals, planned around her night shifts by her Health Coach.
scenes.broll: Close, high-angle view of a woman's hands packing a lunch into a clear glass container on a pale oak worktop in a home kitchen on a bright morning. Her right hand lays sugar snap peas beside a row of six halved cherry tomatoes, a handful of sliced cucumber rounds, two halved boiled eggs and a scoop of green lentil salad; her left hand steadies the container. Beside it: a small wooden board with a halved lemon and a few sprigs of flat-leaf parsley. Only her hands and forearms are in frame, a grey sweatshirt cuff pushed back, short unpainted nails, a woman in her fifties. Low sun from a sash window on the left throws crisp shadows across the worktop. Vertical frame: the upper half is plain sunlit white tiled wall, the hands and container sit just below the centre, the oak worktop fills the bottom. 50mm lens at f/5.6.
scenes.broll_brief: hands preparing a packed lunch of fresh vegetables in a calm kitchen at dawn
scenes.motion: Her right hand slowly sets one more sugar snap pea into the container, then both hands rest still on the worktop. The sunlight stays steady. Fixed camera.

scenes.headline: Reviewed by a UK Clinician who knows her history.
scenes.vo: Her health, reviewed by a UK Clinician who knows her history.
scenes.broll: A woman in her fifties seen from behind, standing on a narrow stone path in the small sunny back garden of a Victorian terraced house in early autumn, holding a white mug of tea in her right hand. She has shoulder-length grey-blonde hair and wears a loose sage-green cardigan over a cream top and dark blue jeans. Beds of lavender and late pink roses line the path, with a weathered wooden bench and a red brick garden wall beyond and a London plane tree above the wall. She is small in the frame, turned fully away towards the bench. Low late-afternoon sun from the right rim-lights her hair and throws long crisp shadows across the path. Vertical frame: the upper half is plain pale blue sky above the brick wall, she sits just below the centre, the lavender and stone path fill the bottom. 50mm lens at f/5.6.
scenes.broll_brief: a woman in her fifties smiling in a sunny garden, relaxed
scenes.motion: The lavender sways gently in a light breeze and she slowly lifts the mug and lowers it again. The light stays steady. The camera pushes in very slowly.

scenes.headline: 4,500+ recipes in her pocket, included.
scenes.broll: Close, high-angle view of two women's hands cooking together in a bright home kitchen at midday. On the left, a hand with a rolled-up navy linen sleeve stirs a red cast-iron pot of chickpea and tomato stew with a wooden spoon; on the right, an East Asian woman's hand with a thin silver ring tips a handful of fresh spinach leaves into the pot from a wooden chopping board. Beside the hob: a halved red onion and a bunch of coriander. Only their hands and forearms are in frame, short unpainted nails, two women in their fifties. Sun from a window on the left lights the rising steam and throws crisp shadows across the worktop. Vertical frame: the upper half is plain sunlit white tiled splashback, the pot and hands sit just below the centre, the worktop edge fills the bottom. 50mm lens at f/5.6.
scenes.broll_brief: two friends laughing while cooking together in a bright kitchen
scenes.motion: Steam rises slowly; the spinach leaves settle into the stew and the wooden spoon makes one slow stir. Fixed camera.
